main_text.p: uidetur,CVM NASCETVR NOMINATIM HEREDEM VEL EXHEREDEM FACIO QVAMVIS, &c. Nam,ut ait Vlpianus L.3.§.1.D.de iniust.rupt. qui post testamentum factū in uita nascuntur, ita demum per legē Velleam rumpere testamentum prohibētur,si nominatim sint exheredati.
Viuente patre.) Vocem VIVENTE, uacare,nemo non uidet.

Nascantur.)Oratio postulat NASCATVR. Mirum est autem, nullam adoptiuorum à Sceuola interpositam esse mentionem, quorum quasi agnatione testamentum rupi constat, ex L.1, & 8.D.de iniust.rupt. Sed ad hanc quoque formulam pertinere certum est, nec testamentum ea formula commu-nitum[?] eorum agnatione rumpi, quod etiam maiori in re Papinianus confirmat L.Titio.23,in fin.D.de lib.&post.
main_text.head: Partitio.
main_text.p: Viuis nobis natos.) Enunc.1. Vellea lex eos qui testatore uiuo nascūtur, si uel instituti uel exhæredati sint, rumpere prohibet.

page.notes: The line break in "com.nu / nitum" is unclear; the word is read as commu-nitum with the second syllable doubtful. The running head letters after "IN L." are not fully legible and are read as GALLVS with doubt. No marginal notes are printed on this page.
